items.title: Mastercam 2024 toolpath programming workflow
items.body:
1. import your cad model into mastercam
2. we'll create a roughing toolpath
3. create a finishing contour
4. add drilling operations for the bolt holes

items.body: The post processor generates g-code for specific machines. Video uses Haas VF-2 with Fanuc compatible control.
